visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White background. Stacked speaker rows (30/60): rectangular landscape photo left, H3 name (sans, regular weight) and bio paragraphs with orange underlined inline links right; thin grey rules between rows.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Stacked full-width rows with a large rectangular photo, H3 name and long bio with inline links; cards-profile (small round portrait, linked name) and cards-portrait (3-up grid) are under 80% similar
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Speaker/biography rows with photo beside name and bio

contentPattern.summary: Repeating photo beside name and bio, one item per speaker, separated by rules
contentPattern.structure: one row per speaker: [photo (optional) | H3 name, bio paragraphs]

blockContent.description: Three invited speakers, each with photo, H3 name and two bio paragraphs with inline links
blockContent.notes: The photo cell may be empty; rules between rows are CSS

usage: List of speakers or people with longer biographies: photo on the left, name heading and bio paragraphs (with inline links) on the right, separated by thin rules. Rows without a photo render text-only.
reuseGuidance: Use for invited speakers, panel members or any people list with full bios. Inline links in the bio stay individually clickable (rows are not whole-row links). Use cards-profile for short linked name + position rows.
